description:
Conduct requirements gathering sessions with new RSA Archer eGRC user groups 
 Basic knowledge of GRC domain 
 Develop workflow models within Archer development environment 
 Datafeed integration with MSSQL/Oracle/DB2/Filesystem/Non-Archer Tools 
 Knowledge of the out of the box solutions and application, User Access,Roles and Groups , 
 Applications and field types, Basic reports and dashboards, 
 Build complex calculation field to implement business rules, Manage assessments using 
 questionnaires, Work with application builder reports 
 Conduct user acceptance testing of workflows and modification made to Archer 
 Deploy finalized products to production RSA Archer eGRC environment 
 Maintain Archer GRC platform components Server hardware, SQL databases, Windows 
 services, RSA Archer product software 
 Develop RSA Archer eGRC data integration feeds to/from other systems as requested 
 Provide regular status report updates on project plans and maintain schedules 
 Develop custom scripts or utility applications to process repetitive tasks and increase team 
 

 

 
 Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education. 
 At least 11 years of experience within the Information Technologies. 
 

   ** U.S. Citizens and those who are authorized to work independently in the United States are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor at this time. 

 Note:- 
 1.This is a   Full-Time & Permanent job   opportunity   for you. 
 2.Only   US Citizen   Green Card Holder  GC-EAD, & TN  can apply. 
 3. No   H4-EAD  L2-EAD     OPT-EAD, H1B   candidates please. 
 4.Please mention your   Visa Status   in your   email or resume.
